input.explanation: No. Everything the fix needs is in this repository. Both model versions are defined in src/io_shop/categorising.py, the only call to `predict` goes through `categorise`, and `categorise` now lowercases titles before the model sees them. So V2 matches capitalised words as V1 does, and `categoriser.model: v2` in deploy/values-production.yaml can be turned back on with no change outside this repo. One caveat: I read main, not revision 7c3ca00c, so the fix assumes that branch's categorising.py matches main's.
